correctness.rationale: Five nonvanishing delay rows have Fourier polynomials of degrees 0,1,2,1,0. Their sampled zero counts are at most one per linear side and one for the unimodular central quadratic, as two sampled quadratic roots would differ by a nontrivial cube root of unity and p>=7 is prime. Central root z0 forces a/c=b/d=omega_3^±/z0, whose product excludes simultaneous two side roots. Thus only 0,1,2 zeros and support sizes 5p,5p-1,5p-2. At minimum, the side-side conditions -d/a=ξ,-c/b=η yield p² disjoint T² components; the central-side conditions (z0,ε,side,ξ) yield 4p² disjoint circles. Explicit phase examples realize all three. Independently checked sample p=7 minimizer equations; all-p classification is algebraic, not numerical.
